notes: Core hooks. Path-neutral by contract: a 'command' or an absolute 'script' is rejected by core/lib/layers.py. install.py resolves 'runner' plus 'script' into an absolute command at write time. See core/CONTRACT.md. Profiles: minimal keeps every control that stops a wrong or unsafe write and drops everything whose only job is to add context, record narrative, or drive a pane. standard is the full wiring. strict is standard plus per-call telemetry.

hooks.description: Creates this session's journal and prints only a real anomaly, so a normal start injects nothing.
Opens the harness session journal at start. Silent when the session scripts are not installed.
Reports this agent's session to Herdr, so a child pane stays addressable and its status stays true. Silent outside Herdr.
Tags this pane as a lead or as a child of a named parent pane, for the agent sidebar. Silent outside Herdr.
Pins a one-line version of the last prompt in this agent's Herdr pane border. Silent outside Herdr.

Runs the Write, Edit and MultiEdit guards in one process. config_protection blocks an edit that weakens a linter, formatter or type checker, which CI cannot catch because the config change arrives with the code it excuses and CI then obeys it.
Runs the Bash guards in one process. no_verify blocks a git command that switches off the pre-commit and pre-push hooks, which is how an unscanned credential reaches history.
Runs ruff, mypy and any configured extra checks after every Python write, and feeds the findings back.
Checkpoints the session journal before a compaction drops the context it came from.
Blocks a hand-off whose turn used a tool and carries no Verified and Gaps footer.
hooks.mandatory_reason: The moment the definition of done is enforced. It already has one named escape hatch, DONE_GATE_DISABLE, which the machine owner sets deliberately; a second route out through a profile would make that decision invisible.

hooks.description: Blocks a hand-off from a session that changed a hook, the generated settings or a registry without a benchmark run describing the change. Reads a recorded run rather than running the benchmark, which takes minutes; the same shape as a gate that reads a recorded verification.
Relabels a parent that is done while a child still runs, so it reads as waiting rather than free. Silent outside Herdr.
Auto-wraps a session that ended without the wrap script, so the journal is never lost.
Reconciles every agent pane's lineage label when this session ends. Silent outside Herdr.
